nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes dependencies, build outputs, repository metadata, documentation, and local Compose files from the Docker build context.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Builds the TanStack application in a Node 22 Alpine stage, then produces a production runtime image containing the server output, Drizzle migrations, upload storage, and boot entrypoint.
nodes.languageNotes: A two-stage build separates dependency-heavy compilation from the runtime image and runs with owned application data.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Installs locked npm dependencies and compiles the application into its production output.

nodes.name: runtime
nodes.summary: Runs the compiled server on port 80 with migrations, persistent upload storage, and a dedicated container entrypoint.

nodes.name: docker-compose.override.yml
nodes.summary: Adds the local-only host port mapping so Docker Compose exposes the application at APP_PORT, defaulting to port 8080.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the production application and PostgreSQL 16 database with health-gated startup, persistent CMS and upload volumes, environment configuration, and restart policies.
